hero_description: No fluff, no fake claims. Here's how we actually compare to Food Tour Malaysia and Secret Food Tours, the two most visible food tour operators in Kuala Lumpur and Penang.
comparison_intro: There are two main food tour operators in KL and Penang besides Simply Enak: Food Tour Malaysia (independent, running since 2012) and Secret Food Tours (international chain with a KL outpost). This page compares Simply Enak against these real alternatives with actual data verified from their websites.
